title: Find the last time you used a machine
summary: Filter History by a saved machine photo to see your sessions on that exact machine, even after training elsewhere.
changes: History has a Filter by machine button. Pick a saved machine photo to list only the workouts where you pinned it, newest first.
The filter shows when you last used that machine, how long ago and how many workouts used it. The most recent session opens with its exercise highlighted.
Open a pinned photo in any saved workout and choose All workouts on this machine to jump straight to its history.
While logging, each saved equipment photo shows when you last used it, to help you pick the right machine when you return to a gym.

image.alt: History filtered by one saved leg press machine, showing it was last used a year ago with the most recent session on it expanded.
